feedback.finish: No one should ever do anything to you without your consent. People aren’t allowed to make you do something you’re not comfortable with.

atoms.finishSound: Consent is agreeing to something or giving permission.

instruction.text: Which words or actions show consent? Drag each block to the correct group.

feedback.finish: It’s important to remember that not being sure is not giving consent. In this case, no one should ever put pressure on you to say yes.

instruction.text: Do these actions need your friend’s consent or not?

atoms.a: going to the toilet during lunchtime
asking your friend if they are feeling okay
telling a friend’s secret to other people

feedback.finish: When your actions will have an effect on someone else, you need to ask for their consent. You don’t want to put them in an uncomfortable situation.
